io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.longDescription:
Read Bidwell Health's official information about online care for urinary tract infection (UTI), bacterial vaginosis (BV), vaginal yeast infection, erectile dysfunction (ED), male pattern hair loss, cold sores, genital herpes, eyelash growth and short-term refills of established medications.

Bidwell Health is a clinician-led US telehealth practice serving Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Iowa, Maryland, Montana, New Mexico, Utah, Virginia and Washington. This read-only connector provides public service coverage, eligibility rules, visit information, care limitations, clinician credentials and links to official pages. Its 12 tools also explain the practice's published bridge-refill rules, location guidance and intimate-health education.

No Bidwell account required. The app does not access patient records. It does not provide personal medical advice, diagnose, prescribe, book visits or take payments. Public service coverage does not determine personal medical eligibility. Do not send personal health information.

pricing.scope: MCP connector access only; clinical visits and medications are separate.
